title: Create: Ultimate Industry
description: Create / Exploration / Adventure-based modpack for Forge 1.20.1
body:
![A mod pack focused on creating mods and adventures that provides one of the best experiences.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b9b03202d071366d53d85b3c2d40d406483ba2c.png)

**A Create-based industrial modpack focused on automation, factories, engineering and exploration**

##  The experiences you can have:
- ⚙️ Create Automation
- 🏭 Industrial Factories
- 🌍 Exploration
- 📦 Storage & Logistics
- 👥 Multiplayer Friendly

# FAQ
**Q:** Is this modpack heavy?

**R:** Yes, but it depends on your PC.

**Q:** What is the main goal of the modpack?

**R:** To provide people with the best experiences when using Create.

**Q:** Was the pack designed more for single-player or multiplayer?

**R:** Both.

## Warning

> This mod pack is still under development, so it's possible that your world may become corrupted in future versions.
